# CCL on real decisions: one US mortgage lender, HMDA 2018-2023 (auto-generated by report.py). EXPLORATORY.

Lender: U.S. Bank National Association (public LEI 6BYL5QZYBDK8S7L73M02); conventional, first-lien, owner-occupied home-purchase applications, originated (1) vs denied (3), asserted.
Reference = a fixed **43% DTI heuristic** (approve iff DTI <= 43). It is NOT the lender's approval policy, so mined rules are predictive associations, not verified tacit policy.
Yearly replay: mine on t-3..t-2, admit on t-1, test on t. Race / sex never mined. HMDA has no outcomes and no credit scores.
For each reported year, the implemented selection rule chooses between two CCL variants using admission-year accuracy and chooses GBM hyperparameters from four
configurations using that same year. Test-year labels do not enter these selection functions, but the study and selection procedure were developed retrospectively,
after these years had been examined.
CIs are pointwise 95% percentile intervals from 2,000 paired state-cluster resamples of test predictions, conditional on the fitted and selected models. They do not
include training or selection uncertainty, assume exchangeable states, and do not establish generalization to other lenders or years.

## Admitted law (CCL selected) with its recorded denial reasons (descriptive provenance, not proof)

| test year | kind | holding | support | replay precision (n) | denials decided (with a reason code) | top denial reasons |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2021 | loosen | `aus != 'TOTAL' AND disc <= 49  => APPROVE` | 11193 | 0.882 (5336) | - | - |
| 2021 | tighten | `jumbo AND ltv > 90 AND disc > 25  => REJECT` | 104 | 0.965 (86) | 83 (83) | {'collateral': 0.663, 'debt-to-income': 0.145, 'other': 0.084} |
| 2022 | loosen | `aus != 'TOTAL' AND disc <= 49  => APPROVE` | 11241 | 0.912 (5608) | - | - |
| 2022 | tighten | `jumbo AND ltv > 90 AND disc > 15  => REJECT` | 184 | 0.963 (109) | 105 (105) | {'collateral': 0.752, 'debt-to-income': 0.152, 'credit history': 0.048} |
| 2022 | tighten | `score_model = '8' AND disc > 15  => REJECT` | 59 | 0.952 (146) | 139 (139) | {'credit history': 0.36, 'debt-to-income': 0.266, 'other': 0.209} |
| 2023 | loosen | `aus != 'TOTAL' AND disc <= 49  => APPROVE` | 10935 | 0.897 (6116) | - | - |

Reading: `disc` = DTI (named so the miner runs unchanged). `aus` = automated underwriting system (TOTAL = FHA scorecard, unexpected in a conventional cohort: needs an HMDA specialist's check).
**Bottom line:** in this selected cohort, a learned DTI cutoff of 49% comes within 0.01-0.18 percentage points of CCL's observed accuracy. Tuned GBM has higher
point-estimate accuracy and denial recall in all three years; the reported accuracy-difference interval excludes zero only in 2021. Neither model equivalence nor
recovery of the lender's actual underwriting policy has been established.
